name: workspace-tabs
tagline: Workspaces work like browser tabs: one line each, colored groups, side by side by dragging.
description: Treat workspaces the way a browser treats tabs: each workspace is one line in the sidebar and Shift-Command-[ and ] step through them, groups get a colored rail like a browser's tab groups, Command-1 to 9 picks a workspace, you drag a workspace onto a pane's edge to show it beside the one you are in, a chat alone in its pane loses its own tab, new tabs open next to the current one, and many tabs scroll instead of shrinking.
